description: The AMS article class; preloads amsmath and amsthm. amsart's \@seccntformat ends in \protect\@secnumpunct, which amsart defines only inside its own \@sect (an \edef, '.\enspace' for a titled head; amsclass.dtx). titlesec sets every level it has no \titleformat for with that label but not through \@sect (titlesec.sty \ttl@@extract, separator zero), so each numbered heading at such a level stopped at 'Undefined control sequence \@secnumpunct' (batch 3b: 54 amsart.A and 53 amsart.B documents, every one holding a titlesec way; num.appendix's own \section among them). The preamble provides amsart's own '.\enspace'; amsart's \@sect still sets it again before each of its own headings, so a document without titlesec typesets as before.
